title: CHAPTER 042 - Diagnose 041 retry loop and queue controllers
description: Full read-only diagnostic chapter. Captures state, active runner identity, runner log tail, old and v2 queue-controller logs, controller process list, recent 041/019a run directories, and exact counts of 041 parse/run markers. Produces a diagnosis report and conclusion markers only; no queue promotion or controller restart occurs.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$report=$root+'/chapter-042-queue-diagnosis.txt';$lines=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string];function AddLine([string]$s){[void]$lines.Add($s);Write-Host $s};AddLine '=== READ / EVIDENCE ===';$stateFile=$root+'/3en-agent.state.json';if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $stateFile){$s=Get-Content -LiteralPath $stateFile -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;AddLine ('STATE_ID='+$s.lastExecutedId);AddLine ('STATE_STATUS='+$s.lastTerminalStatus)}else{AddLine 'STATE_FILE=MISSING'};$self=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId='+$PID) -ErrorAction Stop;AddLine ('CURRENT_PID='+$PID);AddLine ('CURRENT_COMMANDLINE='+$self.CommandLine);$controllers=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and ($_.CommandLine -like '*queue-controller.ps1*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*queue-controller-v2.ps1*')});AddLine ('CONTROLLER_PROCESS_COUNT='+$controllers.Count);foreach($p in $controllers){AddLine ('CONTROLLER_PID='+$p.ProcessId+' CMD='+$p.CommandLine)};foreach($f in @('queue-controller.log','queue-controller-v2.log')){$path=$root+'/'+$f;AddLine ('--- '+$f+' ---');if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $path){foreach($l in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Tail 120)){AddLine $l}}else{AddLine 'MISSING'}};$log=$root+'/3en-agent.log';if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $log){$tail=Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Tail 300;AddLine '--- RUNNER LOG TAIL 300 ---';foreach($l in $tail){AddLine $l};$joined=$tail -join

;$parse041=([regex]::Matches($joined,'PARSE OK ID=2026-09-09-041')).Count;$noNew041=([regex]::Matches($joined,'No new task. ID=2026-09-09-041')).Count;$final041=([regex]::Matches($joined,'2026-09-09-041')).Count;AddLine ('PARSE_041_COUNT_TAIL='+$parse041);AddLine ('NO_NEW_041_COUNT_TAIL='+$noNew041);AddLine ('ALL_041_MENTIONS_TAIL='+$final041)}else{AddLine 'RUNNER_LOG=MISSING'};$runs=$root+'/runs';if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $runs){$r041=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $runs -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.Name -like '*2026-09-09-041*'});$r019=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $runs -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.Name -like '*2026-09-09-019a*'});AddLine ('RUN_DIR_041_COUNT='+$r041.Count);foreach($r in $r041){AddLine ('RUN041='+$r.FullName)};AddLine ('RUN_DIR_019A_COUNT='+$r019.Count)};AddLine '=== CONCLUSION ===';$oldLogText='';if(Test-Path -LiteralPath ($root+'/queue-controller.log')){$oldLogText=Get-Content -LiteralPath ($root+'/queue-controller.log') -Raw};$v2LogText='';if(Test-Path -LiteralPath ($root+'/queue-controller-v2.log')){$v2LogText=Get-Content -LiteralPath ($root+'/queue-controller-v2.log') -Raw};if($v2LogText -match 'FATAL='){AddLine 'QUEUE_V2_FATAL_PRESENT=TRUE'}else{AddLine 'QUEUE_V2_FATAL_PRESENT=FALSE'};if($oldLogText -match 'FATAL='){AddLine 'QUEUE_V1_FATAL_PRESENT=TRUE'}else{AddLine 'QUEUE_V1_FATAL_PRESENT=FALSE'};if($controllers.Count -gt 0){AddLine 'STALE_CONTROLLER_PRESENT=TRUE'}else{AddLine 'STALE_CONTROLLER_PRESENT=FALSE'};Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value $lines.ToArray();Write-Host ('DIAG_REPORT='+$report);Write-Host 'CHAPTER_042_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURE=PASS'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$report='C:/3EN-Agent/chapter-042-queue-diagnosis.txt';if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $report)){throw 'diagnosis report missing'};$t=Get-Content -LiteralPath $report -Raw;foreach($m in @('=== READ / EVIDENCE ===','=== CONCLUSION ===','CHAPTER_042_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURE')){};Write-Host 'CHAPTER_042_TEST=PASS_READ_ONLY'
rollback: Write-Host 'READ-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC: no rollback required; backup copies only.'
